title.zh: SmartLingo V2 第四轮：复用 Konectible 的 AI 密钥同步
title.en: SmartLingo V2 round four: reuse Konectible AI credential sync

purpose.zh: 修复 SmartLingo 发布流程缺失的 AI 提供商密钥同步步骤，为恢复真实场景对话与导师服务建立可验证的运行前提。
purpose.en: Add the missing provider-credential sync to SmartLingo deployment so real-life dialogue and tutor services have a verifiable runtime prerequisite.

zh: 沿用 Konectible 已验证的发布代码：当仓库具备 OpenAI 或 DeepSeek 密钥时，将其作为 Worker 运行密钥同步。
无密钥时保留既有运行状态，不把密钥写进仓库、构建产物或日志。
新增发布契约测试，确保同步在生产构建前执行。
en: Reuse verified Konectible deployment commands to synchronize available OpenAI or DeepSeek credentials into Worker secrets.
Preserve existing runtime state when a repository secret is absent; never write secret values to source, build artifacts, or logs.
Add a release-contract test requiring sync before the production build.

zh: 仅修改生产发布流程及其测试；课程、价格、支付、学习记录和用户资料不变。
en: Production deployment workflow and test only; courses, prices, checkout, learning records, and profiles are unchanged.

zh: 在 Stripe 密钥配置后、Worker 生产构建前，按 Konectible 的同一条件判断与 wrangler secret put 命令同步现有 AI 密钥。
en: After Stripe secret configuration and before the production Worker build, use the same Konectible conditional checks and wrangler secret put commands for available AI credentials.

zh: 新增 AI 密钥同步契约及 460 项完整测试、TypeScript、零警告 lint 通过；敏感扫描、版式矩阵与精确提交部署门禁在本轮提交后执行。
第三轮生产 AI 曾进入离线兜底；密钥同步后必须重新验证，不能仅凭配置变更宣称恢复。
en: The new credential-sync contract, all 460 tests, TypeScript, and zero-warning lint pass; run sensitive scan, layout matrix, and exact-commit deployment gates after this commit.
Production AI previously fell back offline; verify it again after sync rather than claiming recovery from configuration alone.

zh: 若仓库没有对应密钥或 AI 上游仍拒绝请求，服务会继续离线兜底；须根据生产复测确定原因。
日语等十种目标语预审场景对话、实时语音、母语审校和普通付费账号端到端验收仍未完成。
en: If the repository lacks provider credentials or the upstream still rejects requests, AI continues to fall back; production retesting must identify the cause.
Pre-reviewed dialogues for ten target languages, live voice, native-language review, and ordinary paid-member end-to-end acceptance remain unfinished.

zh: 仅复制 Konectible 已验证的可选 OpenAI/DeepSeek 密钥同步方式到 SmartLingo 既有 Cloudflare 发布流程。
en: Copy the verified Konectible optional OpenAI/DeepSeek secret sync into the existing SmartLingo Cloudflare deployment flow.

rollback.zh: 本轮没有数据迁移；如需回退，可恢复上一成功发布流程，已同步的现有 Worker 密钥由 Cloudflare 独立保管。
rollback.en: This round has no data migration; revert to the prior successful workflow if needed. Existing Worker secrets remain independently managed by Cloudflare.
